abstracts.value: We derive evolution equations for the universal twist-3 multi-parton correlation functions that are responsible for the novel single transverse-spin asymmetry in QCD collinear factorization approach. We calculate evolution kernels relevant to the gluonic pole contributions to the asymmetry at the order of $\alpha_s$. We find that all evolution kernels are infrared safe as they should be and have a lot in common to the DGLAP evolution kernels of unpolarized parton distributions. By solving the evolution equations, we explicitly demonstrate the factorization scale dependence of these twist-3 correlation functions. We also discuss the impact of these evolution equations on the phenomenological study of QCD dynamics in the observed large single transverse-spin asymmetries.

titles.title: Evolution of twist-3 multi-parton correlation functions relevant to single transverse-spin asymmetry
